analyst_response.spl_code:
search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:dns earliest=-24h latest=now
| stats
    count as DNS_query_count
    values(query) as domain
    values(dest) as dest
    values(bytes_out) as bytes_out
    dc(query) as distinct_domains
    min(_time) as first_seen
    max(_time) as last_seen
    by src
| eval observation_window=last_seen-first_seen
| eval periodicity=if(DNS_query_count>1,round(observation_window/(DNS_query_count-1),2),null())
| eval jitter="requires_review"
| eval rare_domain_indicator=if(distinct_domains<=3 AND DNS_query_count>=20,"review","unknown")
| eval user_host_association=src
| where DNS_query_count >= 20
| table src dest domain DNS_query_count periodicity jitter bytes_out rare_domain_indicator user_host_association first_seen last_seen
| sort -DNS_query_count
| head 100
